data.body:
[P2] Validate sequences on retirement completion events too

The new `$defs/event.sequence` constraint also applies to `retirement.completions`, but this loop checks only top-level `events`. An otherwise valid record with `io_start` at 30 and a matching retirement-only `io_exit` at 205 carrying `sequence: "1"` still passes `validate_evidence(..., phase="final")`: `observed_retirement_work()` checks sequences only when timestamps tie. The published schema now rejects that same artifact. Apply the optional sequence validation to retirement completions as well, and add a schema/validator parity regression for this case.
